newTypes: ElectricArcRuntimeEndpoints { baseStart, baseEnd, effectiveStart, effectiveEnd, startFrame, endFrame }

changedSemantics: setEndpoints(start,end): updates base runtime anchors only; persistent transforms are preserved

changedNormalizedConfig.startRotation: { pitch, yaw, roll } resolved degrees, non-optional
changedNormalizedConfig.endRotation: { pitch, yaw, roll } resolved degrees, non-optional

liveConfigChanges.mergeLiveConfig: consumes startOffset/endOffset per component (finite-only merge, partial patches keep unspecified components) and startRotation/endRotation per component; NaN components keep previous value
liveConfigChanges.structuralFields: unchanged: segments, quality, simulationBackend, chaosAlgorithm (all new fields are non-structural / no rebuild)

runtimeComposition: 1. resolveEndpoints(): binding (Object3D/object+offset) or direct anchors -> base anchors
2. chord frame from base anchors: N = normalize(end-start); U = N x helper; V = N x U; degenerate chord fallback N=(0,0,1),U=(1,0,0),V=(0,1,0)
3. effective = base + R(pitch,yaw,roll)_XYZ * offset mapped x->U, y->V, z->N
4. rotationZ (whole-arc roll, degrees) applied to both effective endpoints, after composition (identical to 4.1.1 behavior)
5. effective endpoints fed to the shared CPU/WebGPU arc generation path

axes.x: U (chord helper, N x worldY or N x worldX)

coordinateSpace.note: frame derived from BASE anchors once per frame; stable under continuous ribbon updates

rotationSemantics.startRotation_endRotation: local endpoint-frame Euler adjustments in degrees (XYZ order) applied to the endpoint offset; zero offset => rotation unobservable
rotationSemantics.rotationZ: global whole-arc roll around Z applied after per-endpoint composition; NOT reinterpreted

backwardCompatibility: configs with only start/end/rotationZ produce byte-for-behavior identical output (test: zero transforms reproduce legacy output exactly)
editor-relative 'offset' chord remains a derived display value, not part of the engine config
standalone and ribbon-tied modes both covered by tests

serialization.roundTrip: config -> JSON -> normalizeElectricArcConfig -> same effective behavior (test covered)

performanceNotes: per-frame composition allocation-free: reused Vector3/Euler/Matrix4 scratch, addScaledVector accumulation
no JSON cloning in update(); getRuntimeEndpoints() small plain-object allocations are diagnostics-only
setEndpoints() allocation profile unchanged (two anchor vectors as in 4.1.1)

coveredCases: setEndpoints updates anchors without clearing offsets
rotationZ unchanged (90 deg maps +X chord onto +Y)
endpoint rotation produces observable direction change
NaN components fall back to previous value
